cases.name: 02-aliased
cases.notes: `import X as Y` resolves to the original name X.

cases.name: 03-module-import
cases.notes: v1 DEFERRED: `import math_mod` followed by `math_mod.add` requires member-access resolution, which is outside the import-bound precision boundary. T1-B should NOT emit references here.

cases.name: 04-shadowing
cases.notes: Only `outer()` uses the imported `add`. Inside `shadowed()`, a local `add = lambda ...` rebinds and MUST NOT count.

cases.name: 05-star-import
cases.notes: v1 DEFERRED: star imports bind an unpredictable set of names. Without type info or re-scanning the target module, T1-B cannot know which uses resolve through the star. Explicitly not tracked.

cases.name: 06-type-hint
cases.notes: Both the type annotation `-> Point` and the constructor call `Point(0.0, 0.0)` count as reference sites.

cases.name: 07-string-and-docstring
cases.notes: The docstring mention of `add` and the string literal `"add and multiply"` MUST NOT produce references.
